title: Topic 10: Food & Drink / Ordering - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Order food and drink in a cafe; say what you like

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Menu format
CAFE SOL - MENU
Coffee ......... two dollars
Tea ............ two dollars
Milk ........... three dollars
Apple juice .... three dollars
Bread .......... one dollar
Monday to Saturday, eight o'clock to six o'clock.
We are in Olinda!

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Odo: I am hungry, Ema!
Ema: Me too! There is rice and bread in the kitchen.
Odo: I like rice! And juice?
Ema: There is apple juice on the table.
Odo: My sister likes tea. Is there tea?
Ema: Yes, there is. It is very good tea!
